prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Beijing for a bit, and it reminded me of that whole errands week I had back in 2025.
I still laugh about it—my friend Chen Ming ended up renting a Volkswagen Lavida for me, and it was already all sorted before I even landed.
The pickup date was 2025-03-21 and we kept it for 7 days, so by the time I thought about changing anything, it was basically over.
Around the same time, Liu Yang had already reserved me a copy of The Three-Body Problem—honestly I just showed up and grabbed it, no extra steps needed.
